reply_text:
Nadia, Gideon landed on 280 seats for Vantorre Group, and I posted that as a reply to your message in #strategic-pod.

His July 1 update first said 300, but he corrected it about ten minutes later. The 300 had included sandbox logins from their May rollout. The 280 is the active seat count on the production roster as of July 1, and Ruth confirmed it in the thread.

That figure is from July 1, so check it's still current before it goes in the roster sheet.

His correction calls it "Nadia's old industrial account" and doesn't name Vantorre. I treated it as Vantorre because it follows directly from his 300-seat Vantorre update.
